your_steps.title: Set up Jobber fields and run a read-only test
your_steps.when: Before the first live test read; about 15 minutes if accounts already exist
your_steps.detail: Follow OWNER-STEPS.md in one setup session. Create the four pre-written Job Text fields, enter actual values on completed installation jobs, and optionally create a draft test app in Jobber Developer Center for a short GraphiQL read test. Save the app Client ID, Client Secret, and temporary GraphiQL access token in Glacier Settings → Secrets, then run the read-only owner check. The temporary token expires after 60 minutes and does not enable recurring production access. Manufacturer terms review, outreach, publication, email sending, and portal submission are not required for the current local preparation workflow.
